# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We pledge to make participation in this project a harassment-free experience for everyone.

## Our standards

Examples of positive behaviour: empathy, respect for differing viewpoints, graceful feedback.
Unacceptable: sexualised language, trolling, personal attacks, public or private harassment.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behaviour to the maintainers. Complaints are reviewed promptly and fairly.

## Attribution

Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
